name: Rubbing from a Stone Carving of a Luo Ping (1733-1799) Painting of Monks Hanshan and Shide
dimensions:
rubbing: 128.6 x 64.7 cm (50 5/8 x 25 1/2 in.)
mounting, including cord and roller ends: 217.2 x 85.1 cm (85 1/2 x 33 1/2 in.)
summary: This rubbing derives from an engraved stele memorializing a famous painting of the monks Hanshan and Shide by the Qing painter Luo Ping (1733-1799). The original painting is now in the collection of the Nelson-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, Missouri (William Rockhill Nelson Trust, 72–5). The stele, which remains at the Hanshan Temple in Suzhou, was carved by Tang Renzhai sometime between 1875 and 1908.
